model_interpretation.claim: Using 128-thread blocks with 128 items per block may expose more independent target tiles to the GH200 at large N than the 256/256 baseline. A grid-stride target loop preserves complete coverage, including tails, even if launch tile size and thread count differ. Pairwise arithmetic and shared-memory usage remain unchanged; performance is uncertain and must be judged by the controller's prescribed geometric-mean comparison.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/launch.json","src/nbody_kernel.cu"],"retained":["Changed launch settings from block/items_per_block 256/256 to 128/128, keeping shared memory disabled.","Replaced the single output index with a grid-stride loop so every target is covered for any positive launch dimensions, including tails and differing block/tile sizes."]}
